_doc: Proposal values the redesign search (--model=redesign --search=N) may change, as dotted paths into the proposal tables, each with the range it may move in. The search is a coordinate hill-climb: it tries one value up and down by a step, keeps a change that lowers the penalty (failed checks, distance from the target ending time, distance from the spec's per-district minutes), and prints the best set as a --set string.
